summary: Validated backend + frontend for offline-first onboarding resilience and online persistence. Create My Profile now navigates promptly to Home even when all /api calls are unreachable, and online creation still persists correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Several interactive TouchableOpacity elements on Profile screen do not expose testID (gender/activity/conditions/device card), reducing automated test coverage reliability.

action_items: Add missing testID attributes to interactive Profile screen controls to improve deterministic mobile automation.
Investigate recurring Expo console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.
Investigate one non-blocking frontend resource 404 seen during online flow; identify missing asset/request source.
critical_code_review_comments: Offline-first implementation is correct for onboarding critical path: local save + immediate router.replace('/(tabs)/home') + non-blocking syncPendingProfile().
API sync retry is asynchronous and non-blocking from Home/Profile via syncPendingProfile(), matching resilience requirement.
Backend profile endpoint persists and returns normalized profile data without Mongo _id leakage.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_resilience_* backend profile records via API tests and generated web device profiles (Offline Profile, Online Persist) during UI validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public preview URL. Offline onboarding with intercepted /api reached Home in ~125ms; blocked profile POST observed asynchronously; no 'Saving timed out' message displayed; Profile tab loaded cached data while offline. Online onboarding captured POST /api/profile device_id and verified persistence via GET /api/profile/{device_id} == true.
rca_of_issue: Root cause from prior runs: native backend host can be unreachable (internal 10.x/private route), causing old blocking save behavior. Current mitigation works: onboarding no longer depends on immediate backend success. Reproduction in this run by aborting all /api requests still allowed immediate Home navigation and later async sync attempts without timeout UI block.
